newsitem.title: INDIA: India to provide enough for higher state wages.
newsitem.headline: India to provide enough for higher state wages.

text.p: Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Thursday that the Indian government will provide sufficient funds to pay higher wages to government employees as recommended by a pay commission.

"Government will provide money to meet the funds that will be required," the minister said at a news conference in response to a question on whether the government would be able to meet a higher wage burden.
Earlier on Thursday, the Fifth Pay Commission submitted its report to Chidambaram. Its recommendations are yet to be accepted.
Chidambaram said the expenditure will not constrain his efforts to keep fiscal deficit in check.

India's fiscal deficit, which stood at 5.9 percent of the gross domestic product in 1995/96 (April-March), is targeted at 5.0 percent in 1996/97, and the government hopes to reduce it to 4 percent over the medium term.
